content:
marco: Heads up — NovaSense (acct ns-7701) got charged Reserved-M for May on INV-2026-078 but they executed a downgrade to Reserved-S effective 2026-05-05. Billing applied M for entire month. Can we fix and check burst forgiveness?
elaine: Thanks Marco. Can you attach the signed amendment? I need effective date to compute proration.
marco: Attached: NovaSense_AMEND_0505.pdf. Effective 2026-05-05 per signature block.
billing-bot: Generated metering snapshot for account ns-7701 (May 01-31):
```
2026-05-01,committed_units,burst_units
2026-05-01,800000,120000
2026-05-10,800000,220000
2026-05-20,800000,80000
TOTAL,800000,420000
```
kevin: Invoice lines pasted here: 
```
INV-2026-078
Line A: RSRV-M-2025, qty 1, period 2026-05-01 - 2026-05-31, amt $12,000
Line B: OVG-TOK, 420,000 tokens, amt $2,520
Total $14,520
```
elaine: From pricing: RSRV-M = $12k/mo, RSRV-S = $7k/mo. Amendment effective 05-05 so proration: 4 days at M, 27 days at S. Compute: daily M = 12,000/31 = 387.10, daily S = 7,000/31 = 225.81. Prorated M portion (May1-4 inclusive) = 4 * 387.10 = $1,548.40. Prorated S portion (May5-31) = 27 * 225.81 = $6,097.87. New total reserved charge = $7,646.27 (rounding to cents). Original reserved line = $12,000. Delta reserved overcharge = $4,353.73.
kevin: Customer also asked for a one-time burst forgiveness up to 200k tokens due to migration. That was a verbal concession by AM per convo w/ sasha. Overage rate = $0.006/token => 200k * 0.006 = $1,200.
sasha: Confirm I told them up to 200k one-time token waiver. Non-recurring, to be applied for May only.
kevin: So suggested credit = reserved delta $4,353.73 + burst waiver $1,200 = $5,553.73. Rounding CM to $5,553.73. This is > $5k so requires finance_mgr approval.
finance_mgr: Please create credit memo draft with accounting reason "Contract amendment proration + one-time migration token waiver". Include supporting docs: amendment, metering CSV, AM note. Send to me for approval.
elaine: Drafted credit memo CM-2026-014 for $5,553.73. Posting to AR queue pending approval. Attachments linked.
finance_mgr: Reviewed. Approving CM-2026-014. Approval id FIN-APP-7901. Approver note: reasonable concession to preserve renewal.
kevin: Applied credit in AR. Created reissued invoice INV-2026-078-R1 showing credit line (-$5,553.73) and new total $8,966.27. Original invoice marked superseded.
marco: I'll notify NovaSense — sending them the revised invoice and short explanation. Draft msg: "Per our executed amendment effective 2026-05-05 we prorated your reserved commit and applied the agreed one-time migration token waiver. Attached: revised invoice INV-2026-078-R1 and credit memo CM-2026-014."
sasha: Customer replied: "Received. Appreciate the quick fix. Confirmed updated amount looks good. We'll reconcile on our side." :thumbsup: 
elaine: Logged issue in billing tracker BILL-2026-359, attached CM/INV-R1/amendment. Closing once customer posts payment/ACK.
marco: Closing thread. Thanks all.
